subject: AuthZ fleet: SSO/SCIM logs, min-priv proof & runbook
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena.park@careco.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security@careco.com
Date: 2026-02-14T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Request: SSO/SCIM logs + RBAC proof for upcoming SOC2 intake

Hi Rafael,

Hope you’re well. CareCo is starting a scoped SOC 2 intake for our product team (Q2 readiness). Our auditor has asked for evidence showing:

- SAML assertion samples for user logins (include NameID and assertion timestamps)
- SCIM provisioning deltas for the last 30 days (create/update/delete samples)
- An RBAC/role matrix showing least-privilege assignments for service accounts and admins
- A short runbook outlining how Redwood handles a compromised SSO identity (steps and owners)

Can you confirm whether you can provide those artifacts by EOD Wed (2026-02-18)? We can accept redacted samples and a short narrative for anything that is sensitive. If there are known gaps we should know now.

Thanks — appreciate a point person here.

Lena Park
Sr. Security Operations
CareCo Health
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@careco.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-02-15T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SSO/SCIM logs + RBAC proof for upcoming SOC2 intake

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear list. I’ll be the point person on this. Quick plan and commitments: 

1) SAML assertion samples: we can provide 5 redacted assertion rows showing NameID, issuer, authnInstant, and assertion ID. Expect CSV export.
2) SCIM deltas: we’ll extract a 30-day delta snapshot (JSONL) with create/update/delete examples and the associated user IDs.
3) RBAC matrix: internal owners will produce a role->permission sheet with notes on which roles are considered admin/service.
4) Compromised SSO runbook: we have an internal incident playbook; we’ll produce a 2-page cut that maps to your auditors’ scope (notification, containment, rotation, audit steps).

Proposed delivery: attachments + Drive link by Thu EOD (2026-02-18). If you need anything sooner, we can escalate.

Irene will validate redaction for PII; Karthik will assemble the exports.

Rafael
Security & Compliance Program Lead
Redwood Inference

On Mon, Feb 15, 2026 at 09:12 AM Lena Park <lena.park@careco.com> wrote:
> Thanks — that timeline works for us. Auditor preference is CSV/JSONL plus a single PDF runbook.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com, lena.park@careco.com
Date: 2026-02-16T08:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SSO/SCIM logs + RBAC proof for upcoming SOC2 intake

Lena / Rafael — attaching the artifact stubs I’ll be handing off. Notes below on provenance and redaction.

Attachments (stubs):
- saml-assertion-samples.csv (redacted NameIDs, kept authnInstant/assertion IDs)
- scim-delta-snapshot-20260216.jsonl (30-day window; user and group deltas)
- rbac-least-priv-matrix.xlsx (role->permission mapping; service account markers)

Quick provenance notes:
- SAML samples are from our auth proxy audit export (exported via: /infra/auth/export-audit --since 2026-01-16 --until 2026-02-15 --format csv)
- SCIM deltas are produced from the provisioning service changefeed; each line is a delta event (op/create/update/delete) with resource urn and timestamp.
- RBAC matrix generated from internal entitlement service; marked rows where we rely on JIT delegation for elevated privileges.

Redaction approach: we replace email local-parts and full user display names with deterministic hashes; UUIDs preserved. If you need pseudonyms instead of hashes, say so.

Open items for auditor:
- They asked for a ‘proof of revocation’ example for a compromised SSO session. We don’t have a canned revocation event in the 30-day window — we can produce a simulated example with a clear label that it’s synthetic for demonstration.
- Runbook: Rafael / Irene, want me to draft the 2-page PDF and then have Irene sign off on redaction/PII?

Karthik
Principal Platform Engineer (Identity)
Redwood Inference
From: Lena Park <lena.park@careco.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sam.bhatt@careco.com, security@careco.com
Date: 2026-02-17T10:24:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SSO/SCIM logs + RBAC proof for upcoming SOC2 intake

Rafael / Karthik — appreciate the fast turnaround. Two clarifying asks before you send the final bundle: 

1) Auditor wants at least one timestamped SAML assertion covering an actual admin login (not just user logins). If the admin event is sensitive, redact the NameID but keep role/admin tag in the row.
2) For the runbook, we need the remediation timeline (T0, T+15m, T+1h, T+24h) and the specific owners (title + email).
3) Also confirm how many SCIM create/delete rows are in the 30-day snapshot (approx row counts).

If you can include a one-paragraph summary of controls that prevent privilege creep (periodic reviews, automation rules), that would speed auditor review.

Can we get the final bundle and the Drive link by Thu 16:00 PT? If that’s tight, tell us what you’ll delay.

Thanks — Lena
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@careco.com>, sam.bhatt@careco.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-02-18T16:42:00-08:00
Subject: Final: AuthZ bundle + runbook (redacted) — CareCo intake

Lena / Sam — attaching the bundle and sharing the Drive folder below. Summary of deliverables included in the root README.

Attachments (attached now):
- saml-assertion-samples.csv (5 rows: 1 admin, 4 user; admin row has role=admin flagged, NameID redacted)
- scim-delta-snapshot-20260216.jsonl (approx 1,224 delta events; 87 create, 31 delete, rest updates; full JSONL in Drive)
- rbac-least-priv-matrix.xlsx (mapped roles, owners, last review date)
- runbook-authz-handbook-v1.pdf (2 pages; T0/T+15m/T+1h/T+24h with owners listed)

Drive link (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Ccareco-iam-bundle
HubSpot note updated: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4891 (bundle uploaded)

Notes on sensitive items and redaction:
- PII redaction: email local-parts replaced with deterministic hash; external IDs replaced with pseudonyms where required.
- Synthetic revocation example included in the runbook appendix; labeled as "simulated for auditor review".
- Full unredacted logs are available under DSA with your security team if needed (will require a scoped transfer agreement).

Next steps: Rafael to schedule a 30-minute walkthrough for your auditor and our identity team; proposed slot Fri 2026-02-19 10:00 PT. Please confirm.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Security & Compliance Program Lead
Redwood Inference
